title.value: Order Starbucks by voice from a Tesla while driving

introduction.value: A user had Grok Bot in a Tesla place a Starbucks order, confirming the drink and total by voice before ordering.

method.value: The poster said they had been testing Grok Bot in a Tesla for a couple of weeks and used the in-car version, not a phone, while FSD was driving. They had already signed the bot into Starbucks, then ordered by voice; Grok confirmed the drink and total before placing the order, and the poster said “Barista” was just the name of one of their Grok Bots.

outcome.value: It successfully placed a Starbucks order hands-free, and commenters noted the total shown was $7.30. The thread does not spell out the full linking flow, and the poster said this ordering setup was currently limited to paid Grok tiers.

notes.value: The main catch in the thread is access: the poster said this was available to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers at the time, though other commenters said some Tesla Grok features worked on the lower $30 SuperGrok plan.

source_text.body:
Order Starbucks by voice from a Tesla while driving
A user had Grok Bot in a Tesla place a Starbucks order, confirming the drink and total by voice before ordering.
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The poster said they had been testing Grok Bot in a Tesla for a couple of weeks and used the in-car version, not a phone, while FSD was driving. They had already signed the bot into Starbucks, then ordered by voice; Grok confirmed the drink and total before placing the order, and the poster said “Barista” was just the name of one of their Grok Bots.
How it went
It successfully placed a Starbucks order hands-free, and commenters noted the total shown was $7.30. The thread does not spell out the full linking flow, and the poster said this ordering setup was currently limited to paid Grok tiers.
Worth knowing
The main catch in the thread is access: the poster said this was available to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers at the time, though other commenters said some Tesla Grok features worked on the lower $30 SuperGrok plan.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
When I say I want coffee, order my usual from [Starbucks or other cafe] at the location nearest [my route or destination]: [drink, size, customizations]. Read back the drink, pickup location, and total to me out loud and wait for me to say yes before you place the order.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/TeslaLounge/comments/1wnfpvm/grok_bot_is_now_available_in_your_tesla
